label: PF Backlog 632
title: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn

brief.problem: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn
brief.what_adds: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn
brief.why: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn

objective: Make Gate 1.5 evidence binding at Gate 1 and cut review churn by pre-empting recurring findings: a design pre-check checklist, a Gate 1 pending-blocking check, direct-call 1.5/2.5 defaults, and a findings->correction-ledger learning loop.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic check (scripts/dev/gate1_check.py --item <ID>) renders the consolidated Gate 1.5 findings+dispositions and exits non-zero when any BLOCKER or MAJOR is still PENDING.

Gate 1 requires BOTH the consolidated view (architect_review.py gate --item <ID> --gate 1) and the enforcement check (gate1_check.py); both are documented as binding in docs/REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE.md.

A design pre-check checklist covering recurring blocker classes is emitted before Gate 1.5: it is auto-included in every design-mode review prompt (architect_review.py run --mode design) and available via checklist --item <ID>.
Gate 1.5/2.5 default to the direct provider call (architect_review.py run); the sub-agent launch is opt-in only and both paths are documented in config/architect-review.json and docs.

Recurring findings are captured as CORRECTION-LEDGER entries each with an enforcement point, and the findings-per-review trend is persisted to the registered engineering/learnings/review-findings.json report consumed by RAG-PROCESS-MEMORY.
A test covers the PENDING-blocking behaviour: the Gate 1 check fails when a BLOCKER/MAJOR is undispensed and passes when all findings are dispositioned.
approach: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn
verification: renumbered from a colliding BI-PF-1433 (develop already used it for the Azure Blob adapter)

trend report needs RAG retrieval wired separately
rollback: revert the tooling/doc change; the consolidated renderer already exists.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/merge_gate.py (or a new gate validator) and core/code_quality_gate.py so the Gate 1 validation reads the latest Gate 1.5 evidence (via /api/v1/evidence/index + manifest) and enforces a design pre-check checklist loaded from config/ci-cd-gates.json. Add a small checklist schema + validation; reuse evidence event APIs and design_critic.py signals for pre-check scoring.

analysis.rationale: Existing gate modules and evidence APIs cover ~80% of the need; this is an EXTEND of merge_gate/code_quality_gate with a config-driven checklist, not new capability.
